scenes.text: Rules get learned. Vendor scores are black boxes. And a data team takes months.
Meet Concours. Fraud models that keep up with fraudsters.
Answer three questions about your team.
Concours protects the data. IDs scrambled. Card numbers removed. Leaky columns caught.
The newest days are sealed away, as a private test.
The same day, you get a working model, measured in money.
Analysts work a ranked queue, with reasons in plain English. Every verdict becomes a new label.
When fraud shifts, Concours notices, and starts an improvement round.
Solvers from a global network compete to beat your model.
A new version goes live only if it passes five gates.
Version two. More fraud caught, with the same team.
And your private test data never leaves your server.
Concours. Fraud models that keep up with fraudsters.
